pass_semantics: Fixture-based PASS proves execution under the pinned runtime and supplied fixtures; it is not live-model acceptance.
analyst_visibility: simulation qualification is required before analyst-ready handoff when a simulation dependency is available and applicable
runtime_defect_rule: If canonical Ordo is valid and simulation exposes runtime-adapter nonconformance, do not mutate the playbook as a workaround.
dynamic_recovery_rule: Use native semantic_recovery_fixture_points when inspect can expose them; if run returns fixture_incomplete, preserve missing_fixtures.json and missing_model_responses.template.yaml, fill/merge the exact contract, and rerun. Do not classify expected fixture discovery as a playbook defect.
kit_layout_rule: Simulation dependency extraction must support both flat-root kit ZIPs and legacy one-enclosing-root ZIPs without changing semantic behavior.
deterministic_artifact_validation_rule: Mechanical artifact/archive validation is adapter-layer execution of explicit structured contracts. Missing required archive membership/hash declarations are profile contract gaps; never infer them from prose, node names, or Python source, and never fall through to LLM semantic recovery.
profile_contract_gap_rule: Preserve profile_contract_gaps.json, classify it as VIBE_AUTHORING_PROFILE_CONTRACT_GAP, repair the generated-playbook profile contract internally, and rerun simulation before analyst visibility. Do not misclassify it as missing model fixtures or canonical Ordo invalidity.
pre_simulation_contract_rule: Before invoking the runtime simulator, deterministic package-tool and artifact/archive profile contracts must pass factory-owned static completeness gates. Simulation remains the runtime backstop and must still fail closed on any profile_contract_gap.
